title: Star and cross tiles

measurements.how_measured: counted distinct 8-point outlines across upper, middle, lower bands
measurements.statement: count of large patterned 8-pointed star tiles in interlocking grid
measurements.value: 15 full plus 2 cropped at bottom edge, arranged 5 per row across 3 rows

measurements.how_measured: counted cross-shaped gaps between stars and judged patterned vs plain fill
measurements.statement: ratio of ornate star tiles to cross-shaped filler tiles and plain vs patterned fillers
measurements.value: stars : crosses ~ 2:1; about 8 plain mottled fillers to 3 patterned fillers in middle band

measurements.how_measured: eyeballed outer tile extents against frame edges
measurements.statement: panel footprint occupies most of frame centered high with empty surround below
measurements.value: ~90% of frame width and ~80% of frame height, hugging top and side thirds, leaving bottom ~15% empty light background

measurements.how_measured: visual scan for distinct hues ignoring light background
measurements.statement: palette is restricted to off-white ground plus brown-gold range with no saturated hue
measurements.value: 2 earth hues (dark umber-brown and mottled golden-tan) on light neutral, ~70% patterned dark, ~30% plain tan

measurements.how_measured: compared center medallion diameter to outer star diameter on several tiles
measurements.statement: each star has dense central motif with narrow perimeter band
measurements.value: center ornament ~3/4 of star width; border band ~1/10 of star width encircling edge

measurements.how_measured: inspected border script on closest in-focus stars relative to star size
measurements.statement: perimeter text is tiny thin-stroke low-contrast cursive sans-serif-like hand script with tight spacing following star points
measurements.value: script height ~1/20 of star diameter, light weight, narrow width, even thin stroke, continuous around edge

hypotheses.statement: All-over interlocking rhythm of stars and crosses creates unity with no single focal tile; the eye moves across the panel.
Tension and relief come from dense dark patterned stars alternating with sparse plain tan crosses, preventing visual overload.
Mood of aged handmade craft comes from limited earth palette, mottled texture, and variation of central motifs within a strict border system.

relations.rule: Alternate large ornate modules with smaller plain filler modules in an offset interlocking grid with no single center.
Limit colors to a light neutral ground plus one dark and one mid earth tone; allow no saturated accent.
Keep each module as dense center covering ~75% with a thin continuous edge band under ~15% for secondary micro-detail.

fragile_if_changed: If the plain mottled cross fillers were made as busy or dark as the star tiles, the breathing contrast that lets the dense ornament read would collapse.

regions.label: plain mottled cross fillers and palette area
perimeter inscription band on one star

skin_measured.how_measured: k-means (6 clusters) on the sent pixels for bg/fg; accent = median of strongly saturated mid-lightness pixels (s>0.45, 0.2<l<0.8) inside region 'plain mottled cross fillers and palette area'
